title: Cosmic Sorceress with Octopus Orb
description: A female sorceress in an elaborate pink, blue, and green royal gown with white fur trim stands on a reflective cosmic floor, holding a staff topped with a large purple orb containing a pink octopus-like creature with one large eye. Behind her is a giant green moon with a face featuring three yellow eyes and a mouth, set against a starry space background with spotlights, crystal formations, and constellations.
prompt: A powerful sorceress wearing an ornate pink blue and green royal gown with white fur trim and a crown stands in the center of a reflective cosmic floor, holding a magical staff. She has one hand raised. A large glowing purple orb on the staff contains a pink octopus creature with a single large eye, dripping pink liquid. Behind her looms a massive green moon with a detailed face showing three yellow eyes and a mouth, surrounded by stars, constellations, spotlights, and glowing crystal formations in a surreal fantasy space setting.
